aide.title: Help center
aide.subtitle: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about RekoltHt.

compte.title: Create an account
compte.q1: How do I create an account on RekoltHt?
compte.a1: Click "Log in" at the top of the page, then the "Sign up" tab. Fill in your last name, first name, email, phone and password, then submit. You can also sign up directly with a Google account.
compte.q2: What's the difference between a buyer account and a seller account?
compte.a2: Every new account starts as a buyer. You can stay a buyer or apply to become a seller at any time from your profile (see the "Become a seller" section).
compte.q3: Can I create an account under my company's name?
compte.a3: Yes — during sign-up, choose the "Company" tab instead of "Sign up" to create an account under your company's name, with its own email and password.
compte.q4: I forgot my password, what do I do?
compte.a4: On the login screen, click "Forgot password". A 4-digit code will be emailed to you to reset your password.

recherche.title: Search for a product or a seller
recherche.q1: How do I search for a product or a seller?
recherche.a1: Use the search bar on the home page to search by product name or seller name.
recherche.q2: Can I filter results by region?
recherche.a2: Yes, the product catalog lets you filter by category, department and commune to find sellers near you.
recherche.q3: How do I see all of a seller's products?
recherche.a3: From a product page, click the seller's name or "View full profile" to see all their available offers.

devenirVendeur.title: Become a seller
devenirVendeur.q1: How do I become a seller on RekoltHt?
devenirVendeur.a1: From your profile, click "Become a seller". You'll be guided through a multi-step identity verification process.
devenirVendeur.q2: What are the steps of the verification process?
devenirVendeur.a2: (1) Choose your ID document type (passport, driver's license, or ID card); (2) photograph the document; (3) take a selfie; (4) provide your GPS location; (5) review all the information before final submission.
devenirVendeur.q3: What happens after I submit my application?
devenirVendeur.a3: The application is verified automatically, or reviewed manually by an administrator if needed. Once approved, you'll receive a seller contract by email and your account switches to the seller role.
devenirVendeur.q4: Can I publish a product right after approval?
devenirVendeur.a4: Almost: you must first choose at least one product category you sell in, a one-time step, before you can publish your first product.

gererProduits.title: Add and manage your products
gererProduits.q1: How do I add a product?
gererProduits.a1: From the seller dashboard, click "Add a product" and fill in the details (name, price, category, photos...).
gererProduits.q2: How do I edit or remove a product?
gererProduits.a2: From "My products", you can edit the details, mark a product as temporarily unavailable, or delete it permanently.
gererProduits.q3: Why did my product become unavailable on its own?
gererProduits.a3: A product reported repeatedly by users can be automatically disabled while an administrator reviews the situation.

contacter.title: Contact a seller or a buyer
contacter.q1: How do I contact a seller about a product?
contacter.a1: On the product page, use the "Contact" button to open a conversation in the built-in messaging, or the WhatsApp / Call buttons for direct contact.
contacter.q2: Where can I find my conversations?
contacter.a2: All your conversations are available from "Messages" in the menu, with an indicator showing the number of unread messages.
contacter.q3: Can a seller see my personal details before I contact them?
contacter.a3: No, your details are never shared until you start the conversation yourself.

securite.title: Reviews, reports, and safety
securite.q1: How do I leave a review on a product?
securite.a1: On the product page, pick a rating from 1 to 5 stars and add an optional comment.
securite.q2: How do I report a product, a seller, or a message?
securite.a2: A "Report" button is available on product pages, seller profiles, and every message you receive. Your report goes directly to the administrators, never to the person concerned.
securite.q3: What happens if a seller gets too many reports?
securite.a3: Beyond 5 reports for the same reason, the account is automatically suspended: no new products can be published, and all their products become unavailable, until an administrator reactivates the account.
securite.q4: Are my reports anonymous to the seller?
securite.a4: Yes, a reported seller is never told who reported them or why — only administrators see those details.

support.title: Contact us
support.q1: I have a problem I can't solve, what do I do?
support.a1: If you're a seller, use "Contact an admin" from the menu to message the platform's administrators directly.
support.q2: How do I report a bug or make a suggestion?
support.a2: Use the same "Contact an admin" form, or the contact details at the bottom of the home page.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: RekoltHt, the platform that connects producers and buyers across Haiti.
about.missionText: RekoltHt was born from a simple observation: all across Haiti, producers and sellers struggle to find buyers, while buyers struggle to find quality products near them — often because of middlemen who take a share of the price without adding value. Our mission is to connect producers, sellers, and buyers directly across the whole country, free of charge and without intermediaries, so that every transaction benefits first and foremost those who produce and those who buy.
about.value1Text: Creating an account, publishing products, and contacting sellers never costs anything — no hidden fees, no commission on your sales.
about.value2Text: Buyers and sellers communicate directly, by message or phone, to agree on their own terms.
about.value3Text: Thanks to the location map, find sellers near you, in any department of the country.
about.value4Text: Reviews, ratings, and reports let everyone sell and buy safely — problematic accounts are reviewed by our team.
about.ctaText: Whether you're a producer, seller, or buyer, RekoltHt is made for you.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using RekoltHt, you agree to the rules described below. This policy may be updated; the date above shows its latest version.
terms.s1Text: RekoltHt is a free platform that directly connects producers, sellers, and buyers across Haiti. RekoltHt facilitates these connections but is not a party to any transaction: exchanges, price negotiation, delivery, and payment are handled directly between the buyer and the seller.
terms.s2Text: You must provide accurate information (name, email, phone) and are only allowed to create one personal account. Any account starts as a buyer account, and you can later apply to become a seller from your profile. Company accounts follow the same rules, with their own login credentials.
terms.s3Text: To publish products, an account must first complete an identity verification process (ID document, selfie, location), reviewed automatically or manually by an administrator. Submitting false documents or impersonating someone leads to rejection and may result in account suspension.
terms.s4Text: You are solely responsible for the accuracy of the products, prices, descriptions, and reviews you publish. The following are prohibited: selling illegal products, false information, offensive, discriminatory, or misleading content, and fake reviews.
terms.s5Text: Interactions between users (messaging, phone contact) must remain respectful and honest. Harassment, threats, scam attempts, and spam are strictly prohibited, whether directed at another user or found in a message, product, or review.
terms.s6Text: Any user can report a product, seller, message, or review that violates this policy; the report goes directly to the administrators, never to the person concerned. A seller account receiving more than 5 reports for the same reason is automatically suspended: it can no longer publish new products, and all its products become unavailable, until an administrator reactivates the account after review.
terms.s7Text: An administrator may block or permanently delete an account that violates this policy, with or without a prior report. A blocked account immediately loses access to the platform; a deletion is permanent and erases the profile, products, messages, and other associated data.
terms.s8Text: Your contact information (phone, email) is never shared publicly without action on your part: it is only visible to another user once you yourself start a conversation or call with them. Your data is only used to operate the platform (account, messaging, product location) and is never sold to third parties.
terms.s9Text: RekoltHt facilitates connections but does not guarantee the quality, availability, or delivery of products offered by sellers. Each user remains responsible for the agreements they make with another user.
terms.s10Text: This policy may be updated at any time to reflect changes to the platform. Continued use of RekoltHt after an update constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
